INFORMATION

Service policies

Terms & Conditions

JeevanJyoti Foundation provides documentation and digital assistance services based on the information and documents supplied by the client. Clients are responsible for the accuracy, completeness and legality of the information provided. Services must be used only for lawful purposes. JeevanJyoti Foundation does not provide legal advice, legal representation, and does not represent itself as a law firm, advocate, government office or court authority. Service charges are communicated before work is undertaken where applicable. Payment does not guarantee any government, court, institutional or third-party approval or outcome. JeevanJyoti Foundation may decline requests that appear unlawful, misleading or outside the stated service scope. These terms may be updated when necessary.

Privacy Policy

Information shared for documentation work is handled only for the relevant service and is not knowingly shared except where required for the service or by law.

Cancellation & Refund

Cancellation and refund eligibility depends on the stage of work completed and the nature of the service. If work has not started, a cancellation may be considered subject to applicable conditions. Once documentation, typing, drafting or other service work has commenced, any refund will be assessed based on work already completed and reasonable service costs incurred. Government, statutory or third-party charges, where applicable, are non-refundable unless the relevant authority provides otherwise. Please contact JeevanJyoti Foundation before placing a service request if you need clarification.

Shipping Policy

Not Applicable. JeevanJyoti Foundation provides documentation and digital assistance services. No physical products are sold or shipped through this website.
